assumptions: 015/016 establish inclined stone surfaces rising toward a square skylight. Eight-facet transition from the octagonal room trace is a candidate, not a surveyed ceiling outline.
103 floor outline is used as the provisional ceiling lower perimeter; ceiling/wall offset is unmeasured.
Lower ceiling at upper floor plus 2.70 m, top at inherited exterior curb height. Section 101 does not cut this room and does not directly verify these levels.
24 radial lighting arms are visually counted on 016. Tube length, diameter, disk radius, height and luminous output are unmeasured.
015 shows fine suspension wires and fork-like attachment points. Exact wire network and fixtures remain unresolved; this package preserves a simple radial candidate.
The current exterior octagonal lantern is inherited and still unverified; the square interior aperture does not confirm its exterior form.
A clear four-pane candidate and cross framing follow 016; exact layers and hardware remain unresolved.

Ceiling lower perimeter uses a least-squares orthogonal/chamfered octagon fitted to the manual floor trace. Maximum offset is recorded. This is an unmeasured ceiling outline, not a warped source plan; the actual P17 floor remains unchanged.
